items.title: Lorenz Snacks introduces autonomous EVs for in-plant operations
items.summary: Lorenz Snacks is breaking new ground on its private factory premises in Neunburg vorm Wald. At the heart of the project - initiated with technology partner Einride - are four cab-less EVs that will be used to transport finished goods, raw materials, and empty pallets between production and the central warehouse.
facts: The family-owned company employs around 3,000 people and is a major player in the European snack market.
Its product range includes chips, peanut puffs, salt sticks, crackers and nuts.
Well-known brands under the company include Crunchips, Saltletts and NicNac’s.

This allows Lorenz to integrate autonomous transport technology permanently into its plant operations.” Incidentally, the firm was awarded the German Logistics Prize 2026 in October for the underlying logistics concept.
The prototypes deployed, which Einride has most recently referred to as eBot and previously introduced as the Gen 2 Rigid Large, have a loading capacity of 15 Euro pallets.

items.title: トヨタ、次世代カローラやヤリスは1つのマルチパスウェイプラットフォームに 中国での経験を折り込み「量を束ねて原価競争力を引き上げ」
items.summary: トヨタ自動車は11月5日、2027年3月期 第2四半期決算（2026年4月～9月、6か月累計）を発表した。この決算会見において同社代表取締役副社長 宮崎洋一氏はトヨタの将来ビジョンを説明。トヨタが進めている事業構造改革の進捗について語った。
facts: トヨタ、次世代カローラやヤリスは1つのマルチパスウェイプラットフォームに 中国での経験を折り込み「量を束ねて原価競争力を引き上げ」
トヨタ自動車は11月5日、2027年3月期 第2四半期決算（2026年4月～9月、6か月累計）を発表した。
トヨタ自動車は2018年1月開催のCES2018において、豊田章男社長（当時）がクルマ会社からモビリティカンパニーへのモデルチェンジを宣言。
このクルマには主要なAセグメント、Bセグメント、Cセグメントを1つのプラットフォームでカバーするマルチパスウェイプラットフォームが新たに用いられる。
このプラットフォームは、バッテリEV、PHEV、ハイブリッド車、ICE（Internal Combustion Engine、内燃機関）、CN燃料（カーボンニュートラル燃料、水素も含むと思われる）車を1つの車台で実現。
多くの数を1つのプラットフォームで作ることにより、圧倒的な原価競争力を実現していく。
アジアセグメントのクルマの構成はA-Cセグが6割であり、そのうちバッテリEVは23％。
異なるパッケージサイズのクルマを1つのプラットフォームで量産体制にもっていく。
カローラとヤリスを1つのプラットフォームで生産しようとすると、衝突基準なども含めてどうしてもカローラクラスのクルマに合わせた開発になっていく。

items.title: 「正統進化って感じ」「楽しみやなぁ」スズキの新型“丸目”ネイキッドに反響！『SV-7S』日本導入への期待も

facts: スズキが「EICMA 2026」で世界初公開した丸目ライトの新型ネイキッド『SV-7S』が、SNSで話題になっている。

燃費は24.4km/リットル（WMTC）だ。

カラーは「パールスズキディープブルーNo.4」「グラススパークルブラック」「マットソードシルバー／グラススパークルブラック」の3色。
2027年春頃より各国で順次販売を開始するとされているが、日本での正式な発売時期は未発表だ。

items.title: Project JOLT trials prompt three UK hauliers to invest in electric trucks
items.summary: Three UK hauliers are investing in eHGVs after taking part in Project JOLT, a research programme examining the economic and operational viability of electric trucks in commercial freight operations. DP World, Howard Tenens and Port Express are all acquiring new vehicles following the trials.
facts: Led by Professor David Cebon and the Centre for Sustainable Road Freight (SRF), Project JOLT brings together two universities, 15 fleet operators, and five truck manufacturers – as well as three organisations offering project management and software support.
One key finding from the project is that operators could save around £0.21/km in fuel costs by switching from diesel to electric trucks (based on current fuel prices).
Once all ten new trucks are in service, electric vehicles will account for 13 of the site’s 37-strong fleet.
Of the 11 destinations served from Bicester, seven are within range of MAN trucks.

items.title: Only diesel will do: 2000 miles in six days with Mercedes E450D

I'd wager the answer is 'not very'. As I creep off LeShuttle and into the French daylight, I think about the death of the big diesel estate. Audi and BMW have dropped their mile-munching load luggers from sale in the U
facts: I've got a full tank of Rudolf's finest, it's 790 miles to the northern tip of Denmark and I'm behind the wheel of a Mercedes-Benz E450d Estate.
I cross the border somewhere near the old Zolder Formula 1 track, passing into a short and utterly unremarkable section of the Netherlands.
I know this partly because of the signs but mostly because a BMW M6 Cabriolet has just blasted past me at approximately Mach 2.
At present, a litre of diesel will cost you €2.40 (£2.03) out here.

The way the E450d gains speed is oddly sedate.

items.title: 三菱『デリカD：2』次期型は2028年登場？ “ソリオ”から離れ、日産と共同開発も
items.summary:
三菱自動車のコンパクトミニバン『デリカD：2』が、2028年前後に次世代モデルへ移行する可能性が浮上した。スズキ『ソリオ』をベースとする現行型に対し、三菱独自のデザインを強める展開が予想される。日産自動車との協業拡大が、次期型の開発体制に影響するかも注目点だ。
デリカD：2は、スズキからOEM供給を受ける2列シートのコンパクトミニバンだ。両側スライドドアを備え、都市部での取り回しや日常の使い勝手を重視するユーザーに支持されてきた。現行型は2020年に登場。2025年2月の一部改良では、フロントデザインを変更したほか、パワートレインを新世代の1.2L直列3気筒「Z12E」型エンジンとマイルドハイブリッドの組み合わせに刷新した。
◆「ソリオの兄弟車」という位置付けがどこまで変わるか
スクープ班が入手した情報によると、2028年前後に登場が予想される次期型では、従来のOEMモデルとは異なる商品展
facts: 三菱自動車のコンパクトミニバン『デリカD：2』が、2028年前後に次世代モデルへ移行する可能性が浮上した。
デリカD：2は、スズキからOEM供給を受ける2列シートのコンパクトミニバンだ。
現行型は2020年に登場。
2025年2月の一部改良では、フロントデザインを変更したほか、パワートレインを新世代の1.2L直列3気筒「Z12E」型エンジンとマイルドハイブリッドの組み合わせに刷新した。
スクープ班が入手した情報によると、2028年前後に登場が予想される次期型では、従来のOEMモデルとは異なる商品展開が検討される可能性があるという。
『デリカD：5』や『デリカミニ』にも通じるタフなイメージを表現し、「デリカ」シリーズの一員であることを前面に押し出した。
三菱 D：2 次期型の予想CG◆「デリカ」の名称は三菱ブランドを象徴する
三菱は2026年5月に公表した中長期ビジョンで、個性を際立たせた商品とブランドの強化を掲げた。
国内市場ではデリカD：5とデリカミニが独自の存在感を示しており、デリカの名称は三菱ブランドを象徴する重要な資産となっている。
次期デリカD：2でも、コンパクトミニバンとしての実用性を維持しながら、より明確なデリカらしさを追求することが考えられる。
さらに日産は、2028年度以降の日本市場に、新たなコンパクトファミリーを投入する計画を明らかにしている。
現時点で、この新型コンパクトファミリーと次期デリカD：2との直接的な関係は明らかになっていない。

facts: ホンダは11月3日、東京・江東区の夢の島マリーナを会場に、株主優待イベントを開催した。
ホンダならではの株主優待を提供することで株式保有の長期化やファン株主の拡大をめざすもので、今回は、日本ではあまり馴染みがない「マリン事業」にフォーカスし、応募した20組48名の株主とその家族がボートによるクルージングを通じてホンダマリンの世界を体感した。
ホンダ株主優待 マリン体験会（11月3日）ホンダは1984年から株主優待のひとつとして工場見学会を開催してきた。
このほか、レース観戦やファンイベント「Enjoy Honda」開催などをおこなってきたが、2023年3月に株主優待の取り組みを大幅刷新。
2025年には新たに「Honda Jet体験会」「モビリティリゾート体験会」「セーフティスクール体験会」「ラグビー観戦」そして「マリン体験会」を開催。
実際、今回のマリン体験会へは8200名を超える応募があり、その倍率は410倍にものぼる。
株主数そのものも右肩上がりで増加しており、株主優待の刷新、個人投資家向け説明会の開催、株式分割による投資単価の引き下げや、株主総会へのバーチャル方式導入などの効果で、2023年3月時点で21万5508件だった株主数は2026年6月に73万超と約3.4倍になった。
ホンダ株主優待 マリン体験会（11月3日）特に体験型優待への期待や満足度が高く、参加した株主はブランドへの理解を深めるだけでなく、株式の長期保有にもつながっているという。

items.title: Apollo’s newest electric scooter is also its lowest-cost yet
items.summary: Apollo has spent the last several years carving out a spot for itself toward the more premium end of the electric scooter market. Now the company is trying something different: going after the mass market with its least expensive model yet. more…
facts: The new Apollo Dash carries a $699 MSRP, but is launching at $599 as part of the company’s Black Friday sale running through November 30.
The scooter uses a 48V electrical system powering a 600W nominal, 1,200W peak-rated Bosch motor, with a top speed of 20 mph (32 km/h).
Its 480Wh battery is rated for up to 25 miles (40 km) of range in Eco mode.

Apollo also claims the 48V architecture avoids limiting motor power to anemic levels as the battery drains, meaning riders shouldn’t experience the same increasingly sluggish performance toward the bottom of the battery that can occur on some lower-cost scooters.

items.title: SNE Research: Chinese OEMs increasingly dominate global EV battery market
items.summary: In the first nine months of this year, Chinese manufacturers secured more than half of the battery market for electric and hybrid vehicles outside China - while Korean and Japanese suppliers lost ground. This is according to a new analysis by SNE Research.
facts: The key finding: the total capacity of these batteries climbed to 426.7 GWh from January to September.
The market thus grew by 24.7 per cent compared to the same period the previous year.

“The combined market share of the six Chinese companies, including [CATL, BYD, Gotion, SVOLT, CALB and EVE] rose 13.3 per cent from 43.1 to 56.4 per cent, exceeding half of the non-China market,” writes SNE Research.
CATL and BYD alone account for 44.5 per cent of the market.
In the same period in 2023, this figure was still 36.7 per cent.
While SNE Research certifies 24.7 per cent growth for the global market excluding China, the increase including China is only 19.7 per cent.

facts: KDDIとnewmoが資本提携 2028年に大阪府堺市で自動運転タクシーの商用化へ
KDDIとnewmoは11月6日、自動運転タクシーの社会実装に向けた資本提携を締結したと発表した。
さらに、KDDIスマートモビリティを加えた3社で、地域交通の課題解決に向けた業務提携も締結。
newmoの自動運転技術とKDDIの通信・AI基盤などを組み合わせ、2028年に大阪府堺市で自動運転タクシーの商用化を目指す。
3社は堺市での商用化とともに他地域への展開も視野に入れており、堺市で開発・検証した配車、運行管理、遠隔監視などの機能を全国の交通事業者に提供することを検討。
政府は2030年度までに、バスやタクシーなどの自動運転サービス車両を全国で1万台導入する目標を掲げており、車両技術と旅客運送事業の運営を一体で整えることが求められている。
KDDIも10月に「アライアンスパーク・プロジェクト」を始動し、堺市をAIの社会実装を進める拠点と位置づけた。
現在は全国で1900台規模のタクシーを運行しながら、自社の技術で交通課題の解決を目指しています。
KDDI 取締役執行役員常務 CSO 兼 CDOの勝木朋彦氏は「KDDIは中期経営戦略『Power-to-Connect 2028』において、通信・AIが労働力を補完する社会を想定し、デジタルベルトなど当社インフラの活用領域を拡張していく方針を策定しました。

items.title: How Far Can Your EV Go After It Says It’s Empty?
items.summary: Journalists drove 15 EVs until they stopped. The Tesla Model Y went nearly 19 more miles, while another EV barely made it half a mile.
facts: Journalists drove 15 EVs until they stopped.
The Tesla Model Y went nearly 19 more miles, while another EV barely made it half a mile.
- All 15 EVs kept going after the dash showed empty.
They averaged another 10 miles (16 km).
- The Leapmotor B10 went farthest at 19.9 miles (32 km), followed by the Tesla Model Y at 19.3 miles (31 km).
The Xpeng P7+ stopped after just 0.6 miles (1 km).
- A car can show 0% charge while it still predicts some range; 0% and zero miles don't always coincide.
In a Tesla Model Y Long Range, you’d pull in with miles to spare, while in an Xpeng P7+, you’d have been on the phone with roadside assistance, even if the Xpeng goes farther on a full charge.

items.title: Tesla to phase out Cybertruck production in Texas in favour of Cybercab
items.summary: Tesla will phase out production of the Cybertruck at its Texas plant mid-next year. This will free up space to allow the Robotaxi Cybercab to be built in larger quantities. It remains unclear whether the Cybertruck will be completely discontinued or if it will be produced elsewhere in the future.
facts: We recall that in July 2023, Tesla celebrated the start of production.

The US electric vehicle manufacturer does not release registration figures for the Cybertruck, instead grouping its sales under “other vehicles.” This category has always accounted for only a fraction of Tesla’s total sales, which are dominated by the Model Y and Model 3.
The manufacturer introduced a new base Cybertruck model with all-wheel drive, priced from $59,990.
This represented a substantial discount: previously, the cheapest Cybertruck cost $79,990.
Although Tesla briefly offered a single-motor, rear-wheel-drive Cybertruck RWD for $70,000, it discontinued this variant in September 2025 due to insufficient demand.

items.title: Chinese EV Hits 312 MPH To Become The World's Fastest Production Car: Onboard Video
items.summary: BYD's Yangwang U9 Xtreme reached 503.17 km/h on a public road in Abu Dhabi, beating its own record set in Germany last year.
facts: Chinese EV Hits 312 MPH To Become The World's Fastest Production Car: Onboard Video
BYD's Yangwang U9 Xtreme reached 503.17 km/h on a public road in Abu Dhabi, beating its own record set in Germany last year.
BYD's luxury brand, Yangwang, has pushed its U9 Xtreme hypercar beyond 500 km/h (310.7 mph), reaching an astonishing 503.17 km/h (312.65 mph) in Abu Dhabi.
The record-breaking run took place on November 1, along Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed International Road (E11), in Abu Dhabi's Al Dhafra region.

items.title: A NASCAR Driver Bought An Actual Tank. Now The HOA Isn't Happy
items.summary: A decommissioned tank turns a broken $800 Chevy Cobalt into scrap metal, cutting short a cheap-car challenge with neighbors watching.
facts: A decommissioned tank turns a broken $800 Chevy Cobalt into scrap metal, cutting short a cheap-car challenge with neighbors watching.
Carson Hocevar showed up with an $800 Chevy Cobalt.
His buddy Vernon Hale brought a Cutlass Supreme for the same price, and the plan was a cheap-car challenge, the kind where two guys with $800 each see who built the better beater.
The $800 Car Challenge Started With A Cobalt And A Cutlass
The budget was simple: $800 cash, one car each, no other rules.
Carson filled the tank with Unleaded 88 instead of the gas the engine actually needed, a mix-up Vernon called out on camera before the car even left the station lot.

items.title: Chery recalls over 50,000 Omoda, Tiggo 5x cars in China following Malaysia recall
items.summary: Chery recalled 8,878 Omoda 5 cars in Malaysia last month over a similar rear axle welding issue and launched an inspection of same-batch models in China. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - Chery recalled 8,878 Omoda 5 cars in Malaysia last month over a similar rear axle welding issue and launched an inspection of same-batch models in China.
- The recall affects 53,882 Omoda series and Tiggo 5x vehicles produced between June 2022 and December 2023.
Chery Auto (HKEX: 9973) is recalling more than 50,000 Omoda series and Tiggo 5x vehicles in China due to a potential rear axle welding defect.

Starting from November 27, Chery will recall a total of 53,882 Chery Tiggo 5x and Omoda series vehicles produced between June 6, 2022, and December 31, 2023, according to an announcement released on Friday by China's State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR).

items.title: 「Carstayマイル」開始、キャンピングカーのカーシェアと車中泊スポット利用で特典
items.summary:
Carstay（カーステイ）は、キャンピングカーのカーシェアや車中泊スポットのシェアリングなどを対象にした制度「Carstayマイル」を開始した。
Carstayマイルは、サービス利用でマイルを貯め、割引や特典に充当できる仕組み。カーシェアは平日1時間につき10マイル（100円相当）、土日・祝日は1時間につき5マイル（50円相当）を返却後に付与する。車中泊スポットは1泊50マイル（500円相当）を付与する。
また、新規会員登録で100マイル（1000円相当）を付与するほか、事故防止スライドの確認で1予約につき50マイル（500円相当）を返却後に付与する。カーシェアの利用は、前回返却日から90日以内に再度利用すると、利用時間に応じて付与マイルが2倍になる。
貯まったマイルは、カーシェア利用料金の割引（共同使用料／レンタル料とオプション料が対象）に充当できる。対象は「マイル利用可」バッジの付い
facts: カーシェアは平日1時間につき10マイル（100円相当）、土日・祝日は1時間につき5マイル（50円相当）を返却後に付与する。
車中泊スポットは1泊50マイル（500円相当）を付与する。
また、新規会員登録で100マイル（1000円相当）を付与するほか、事故防止スライドの確認で1予約につき50マイル（500円相当）を返却後に付与する。
カーシェアの利用は、前回返却日から90日以内に再度利用すると、利用時間に応じて付与マイルが2倍になる。
対象は「マイル利用可」バッジの付いた車両で、72時間以上の予約が条件。
充当は1マイル（10円相当）から最大5000マイル（5万円相当）まで可能だ。
さらに、Carstayが製造・販売するキャンピングカー「SAny.VAN」の購入代金にも1マイル＝10円相当として利用できる。
会員ランクは累計獲得マイルに応じてブロンズ、シルバー（1000マイル以上）、ゴールド（3000マイル以上）、プラチナ（5000マイル以上）の4段階で構成する。
ランク昇格時には、シルバーで100マイル、ゴールドで300マイル、プラチナで500マイルを付与する。
マイルの有効期限は、最後にマイルを獲得した日の翌日から730日間で、獲得のたびに延長される。
対象は2026年11月4日時点の会員で、2025年6月1日から2026年5月31日までのカーシェア利用回数に応じて500マイルから2000マイルを付与する。

items.title: Volkswagen introduces battery preconditioning for older ID. models
items.summary: Volkswagen is updating the functions of older electric cars in its ID family. With ID. Software 3.9.1, manual pre-conditioning of the high-voltage battery before DC fast charging is being introduced. This OTA update also improves thermal management, AC charging, and system stability, among other things.
facts: Drivers Club, VW stated that 3.9.1 software will be shortly be distributed as an over-the-air (OTA) update.
It targets vehicles with software generation 3.x, primarily including ID.4 and ID.5 models built before October 2023, ID.3 models built up to 2024, and early units of the ID.
Later model years of these vehicles were equipped with newer software generations that offer more features than generation 3.x.
The new preconditioning feature in version 3.9.1 enables the battery to reach an optimal temperature for DC fast charging before arriving at a charging station.
The new function is activated via an additional interface in the infotainment system.

items.title: 313 MPH Yangwang U9 Xtreme Is First Production Car To Break 500 KMH
items.summary: BYD's 2,959 hp electric hypercar beat its own top speed record with a blistering 312.66 mph run on a public highway in Abu Dhabi
facts: 313 MPH Yangwang U9 Xtreme Is First Production Car To Break 500 KMH
BYD's 2,959 hp electric hypercar beat its own top speed record with a blistering 312.66 mph run on a public highway in Abu Dhabi
A Yangwang U9 Xtreme electric hypercar has just hit 312.66 mph to set a new top speed record for production cars.
And it's not just that the U9X is the fastest car on the planet that makes the run so significant.
Because Yangwang already owned that record, having recorded 308.3 mph (496.22 kmh) in 2025, when it dethroned the 304.8 mph (490.48 kmh) Bugatti Chiron Super Sport 300+.

items.title: 5000 electric Volkswagens hit with 80% charge limit over fire risk
items.summary: Owners of some ID 3, ID 4, ID 7, Buzz and Cupra Born models are unable to fully charge until the battery is checked Owners of some electric Volkswagen and Cupra models have been prevented from charging their cars past 80% over concerns that the battery could overheat and catch fire. The Volkswagen Group is preparing to issue a recall for selected ID 3 , ID 4 , ID 7 , ID Buzz and Cupra Born models
facts: Owners of some electric Volkswagen and Cupra models have been prevented from charging their cars past 80% over concerns that the battery could overheat and catch fire.

The Volkswagen Group is preparing to issue a recall for selected ID 3, ID 4, ID 7, ID Buzz and Cupra Born models produced between 2022 and 2025 in order to check that their battery components "meet quality standards".
A recall issued in other markets also includes Audi Q4 E-tron models produced during that period, but the SUV is not listed by the UK notice.
The notice applies to around 5000 cars in the UK, Autocar understands, of some 85,000 worldwide.

items.title: Energica rises from the ashes with plans for cheaper electric motorcycles
items.summary: Energica is officially back. The Italian electric motorcycle maker, which ceased operations in 2024 after entering judicial liquidation, has announced a major revival under new international ownership. And while the Energica name is returning, the company behind it is going to look quite different this time around. more…
facts: The Italian electric motorcycle maker, which ceased operations in 2024 after entering judicial liquidation, has announced a major revival under new international ownership.
Perhaps the biggest change is where the motorcycles will actually be built.
The new manufacturing setup is expected to significantly reduce production costs, allowing Energica to cut motorcycle prices by around 20% compared to its previous models.
After that, Energica plans to progressively restart production of the Ego, Eva Ribelle, and EsseEsse9, eventually bringing its entire previous lineup back to market.

items.title: The 2027 GMC Sierra's V8 Is More Powerful, But Less Efficient
items.summary: EPA ratings show every V8-powered 2027 GMC Sierra 1500 trails the Duramax diesel in combined mpg across two-wheel and four-wheel-drive trims.
facts: The 2027 GMC Sierra's V8 Is More Powerful, But Less Efficient
EPA ratings show every V8-powered 2027 GMC Sierra 1500 trails the Duramax diesel in combined mpg across two-wheel and four-wheel-drive trims.
GM's own 2027 fuel economy table for the Sierra 1500's redesigned engine lineup finally shows how the new V8s stack up.
The numbers settle a trade-off truck buyers have been asking about since the engines were announced: the returning 3.0-liter Duramax diesel still beats the gas V8s at the same trim levels.
The two-wheel-drive 5.7-liter V8 posts 15 mpg city, 19 mpg highway, and 17 mpg combined, while the diesel in comparable 2WD trims carries a 25 mpg combined rating.

items.title: Elon Musk Says Tesla Cybertruck Production Will Wind Down Next Year
items.summary: It's unclear whether production will shift to another factory or Tesla is preparing to retire its wacky truck altogether.
facts: Elon Musk has confirmed that production of the controversial electric pickup will wind down around mid-2027, allowing the automaker to make room for increased Cybercab output.
First unveiled in November 2019, the Cybertruck was unlike anything else on the road.
A $39,900 Promise That Never Materialized
The Cybertruck was supposed to start at $39,900, but when customer deliveries finally began in November 2023, the entry-level model cost considerably more.
The company once targeted annual production of 250,000 units, but actual sales have fallen well short of that ambition.

facts: ヤマハが「EICMA 2026」で初公開した新型アドベンチャー『テネレ4コンセプト』が、SNSで話題になっている。
【詳細画像】ヤマハの新型アドベンチャー『テネレ4コンセプト』
『テネレ4コンセプト』は、ヤマハ発動機が11月3日にイタリア・ミラノで開いたプレスカンファレンスで発表したモデル。
ユーザーから多くの要望が寄せられていた「小さいテネレ」にあたり、A2免許（35kW＝約47.6馬力以下）に対応した軽量・軽快なアドベンチャーバイクとして開発が進められている。
ヤマハのアドベンチャー分野の歴史は、1979年の第1回パリ・ダカールラリーで総合優勝した『XT500』が原点。
1982年の『XT600』テネレで「テネレ」の名が広まり、以来40年以上、オフロード走破性を核にしたアドベンチャーバイクの代名詞として欧州を中心に支持されてきた。
排気量は未発表だが、名称から400ccクラスと予想される。
新設計フレームは軽量性と高い剛性を両立し、『テネレ700』の経験をもとにフラットで低いタンクシルエットとスリムなプロファイルを採用。
ヤマハ テネレ4 コンセプト足まわりはKYB製サスペンション、前21インチ・後18インチのスポークホイール、ミシュラン・アナキー・ワイルド、チタン製アクラポヴィッチ製エキゾーストを装備する。
X（旧Twitter）では、そのデザインについて「テネレ4コンセプトかっこいい！
やっぱりタンクからシートの一直線は良いな」「テネレ4コンセプト、カッコエェ…」「テネレ4まだコンセプトモデルだけどカッコ良い」など高評価の声が寄せられている。

items.title: Over A Quarter Of BMW, Mini, And Rolls-Royce Models Sold In Q3 Had A Plug

facts: Over A Quarter Of BMW, Mini, And Rolls-Royce Models Sold In Q3 Had A Plug
- BMW Group’s third-quarter EV sales reached 20% globally.
- After throwing plug-in hybrids into the mix, the percentage reaches 27.4%.
- Europe leads the way, with nearly 35% of cars sold in Q3 being EVs.
The BMW Group, which operates the BMW, Mini, and Rolls-Royce car brands, saw 20% of its global vehicle sales in the third quarter represented by all-electric models.

items.title: This Corvette ZR1X Has A $400,000 Markup. The Dealer Calls It 'Extreme Exclusivity'
items.summary: One Arkansas Chevrolet dealer wants $696,445 for a Corvette ZR1X convertible, citing demand despite Chevrolet avoiding any official limited-production label.
facts: This Corvette ZR1X Has A $400,000 Markup.
One Arkansas Chevrolet dealer wants $696,445 for a Corvette ZR1X convertible, citing demand despite Chevrolet avoiding any official limited-production label.
George Nunnally Chevrolet in Arkansas has put a Corvette ZR1X convertible up for sale at $696,445.
It's a $296,445 sticker price plus a $400,000 line item the dealer calls an "Exclusive Market Value Adjustment."
The car in question is a loaded ZR1X 3LZ convertible, not the entry-level coupe.
Recent 2027 pricing guides put the ZR1X 1LZ coupe at a $227,695 MSRP before tax, title, license, and dealer fees.

items.title: 自動運転バス、静岡県富士市で実証運行開始…先進モビリティが参画
items.summary:

実証運行は2026年11月6日（金）から11月15日（日）まで。東海道新幹線「新富士駅」と東海道本線「富士駅」を結ぶルートで運行し、土日には新富士駅と田子の浦港を結ぶルートも追加する。

items.title: 三菱自動車、通期営業利益を700億円に下方修正 中間決算
items.summary:
三菱自動車は11月6日、2026年度上期（4～9月）の連結決算を発表した。
売上高は前年同期比4％増の1兆3088億円、営業利益は77％増の306億円だった。いっぽう、アセアンや豪州での販売減少や資材費の高騰を踏まえ、通期の営業利益見通しを従来の900億円から700億円に引き下げた。
●赤字幅は縮小
上期の営業利益率は前年同期の1.4％から2.3％に改善した。経常利益は13％減の138億円、親会社株主に帰属する中間純損失は30億円となった。前年同期の92億円の純損失から赤字幅は縮小した。
営業利益の増減要因では、為替が302億円、売価などの改善が115億円の増益に寄与した。いっぽう、販売台数・車種構成が118億円、販売費が112億円、資材費・輸送費が242億円の減益要因となった。米国関税支払額の減少なども利益を下支えした。

Tesla Is Killing The Cybertruck To Make Room For More Robotaxis
items.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the company will “wind down” production of the controversial pickup in Texas.
facts: The angular truck went on sale at the end of 2023 and instantly became a social statement—for better or worse.

The unpainted truck had a short burst in popularity at the beginning of its production run, but interest fizzled, and sales never reached the potential that Musk and Tesla had envisioned back in 2019, when the vehicle was first presented as a concept.
In this year’s third quarter, the Cybertruck amassed 4,323 sales, according to data from Cox Automotive.
From January through September, sales totaled 11,586 units.
Tesla doesn’t break out individual sales figures for the Cybertruck, but industry estimates put the vehicle’s overall deliveries at roughly 70,000.

Chinese brands have been persuasive in selling us SUVs slightly bigger than our normal comfort
facts: China's largest, premium SUVs are set to go on sale in Europe after dominating their home market The claim that China’s car industry is exporting its overcapacity isn’t being disproven by the recent decisions of brands including BYD , Freelander , iCaur , Jetour and Zeekr to sell 5m-long SUVs in Europe.
Chinese brands have been persuasive in selling us SUVs slightly bigger than our normal comfort zone of around 4.5m, but these Goliaths are well outside that.
This isn’t a targeted strategy but more a spray-and-pray, given that 5m-long SUVs here are a tiny category dominated by a handful of entrenched premium brands.

items.summary: The Honda Avancier is an upcoming hybrid SUV with a rumored three-row layout, which set to be produced in Thailand and sold in Australia and Japan.
facts: The original Avancier was an Accord-based wagon sold in the Japanese market between 1999 and 2003.
The second generation that followed in 2016 was a Chinese-built crossover from the GAC Honda joint venture, sharing its underpinnings with the previous-gen Acura MDX.

While the automaker didn't share any details about the specifications, the teaser video features Honda Hybrid lettering instead of the traditional e:HEV that has been used in electrified Hondas since 2020.

facts: BMW’s Next Electric Wagon Spied Ahead Of 2027 Reveal: Video
Car paparazzi have caught the i3 Touring racking up miles during testing at the Nürburgring.

The new i3 Touring has been caught on video testing at the Nürburgring, giving us another glimpse of the electric wagon that's shaping up to be one of the more interesting additions to the Neue Klasse family.
The footage shows a partially camouflaged prototype putting in laps at the Green Hell.
Although there's some disguise at the front, we can't imagine BMW making major changes, if any, compared to the i3 sedan.
First, it's standard on the i3 sedan, so it'll likely be standard on the wagon as well.

items.title: Honda Alpha Name Revealed For Honda's First Global Electric SUV
items.summary: India becomes Honda Alpha's first launch market and global production base, with specs, pricing, and export timing still unannounced.
facts: The vehicle will make its global debut in India on December 2, 2026, and that same country will build every one that follows.
That production commitment arrives as Honda works through a wider shift toward electrified lineups.
The move overlaps with the company's parallel global hybrid rollout plans.
The new emblem pairs with Honda's H badge heritage, which dates back to the early 1960s.
The SUV itself is closely related to the Honda 0 Alpha concept shown at the Japan Mobility Show, and the Alpha is reportedly the production version.
A teaser image showing the vehicle under a cover also reveals a silhouette with a high square-cut rear that strongly recalls the 0 Alpha's profile.

items.title: Classic cars can do the everyday: 2500 miles in my E30 BMW 325i

I may have taken it a bit far by buying this E30-generation 325i Touring from 1990. Ever since selling my Porsche 944 four years ago, I've had a hankering to own an old car again. Something simple, light, moderately interesting and, above all, fun.

facts: ブリヂストンは、日野自動車の大型トラック新型『プロフィア』の新車装着用タイヤとして、「ECOPIA M803A」（エコピア エムハチマルサンエー）を納入すると発表した。

items.title: Rebranding or reblanding? Car logos are trading character for cleanliness
items.summary: Vauxhall and McLaren are the latest to adopt bold, simple new emblems - but where's the individuality? So the Griffin has become the latest prey of simplification syndrome, with the Vauxhall logo one of many that have in recent years been made increasingly basic and two-dimensional. One aspect of the new look feels deliberate: the griffin has laid down her flag ('her' because in heraldry female gr
facts: It's the first time in 111 years she hasn't held one aloft.
See also McLaren's recent redoing , the flattenings of Lotus (2019), Volkswagen (2019), Citroën (2023), and many more besides.

Less so, perhaps, the hardware and software creators whose myriad technologies, despite their vast cost and complexity, have apparently limited ability to show complicated three-dimensional logos at different scales.
Tricky or three-dimensional designs are out and simpler, more scalable, more easily presented monochrome styles, which must look the same on a poster or at a mere 120x120 pixels, are in.
All life on earth can trace its lineage back to single-cell organisms from billions of years ago.

2026年1～9月期の売上収益は2兆2152億円と、前年同期の1兆9103億円から3049億円増加した。
営業利益は前年同期の1122億円から2352億円へと1230億円増加し、営業利益率は5.9％から10.6％へ4.7ポイント改善した。
営業利益の変動要因を見ると、販売影響による増益効果は917億円。
このうち販売規模の拡大が387億円、価格転嫁やリベートを含むプライシング効果が311億円を占めた。
一方、原材料費などのコスト上昇による影響は517億円のマイナスとなったが、148億円のコストダウンで一部を吸収。
研究開発費の削減で113億円、販売管理費の削減で42億円の増益効果があった。
為替影響も432億円のプラスとなった。
期間中の平均為替レートは1ドル159円、1ユーロ184円で、前年同期の148円、166円から円安が進んだことが利益を押し上げた。
また、米国の固定資産売却による160億円の利益計上も寄与した。
一方、米国関税による営業利益への影響は187億円のマイナスとなっている。

items.title: 「マルチアンプ接続」の実行法はさまざま！ 楽しみながら吟味してベストを選択！［外部パワーアンプで限界突破！］第10回
items.summary:
音にこだわるカーオーディオ愛好家たちは、敢えて「外部パワーアンプ」を使っている。当連載では、これを用いることの意味、そして選び方、使い方までを解説している。今回は、「マルチアンプ接続」を行う場合の「外部パワーアンプ」の使い方のいろいろを解説する。
「マルチアンプ接続」は音に効く。ゆえに愛好家の多くがこれを実践！
さて、前回までの記事にて説明してきたとおり、「外部パワーアンプ」を導入する際にはこれを「マルチアンプ接続」して使われる場合が多い。なお「マルチアンプ接続」とは、「外部パワーアンプ」の1chずつの出力を1つ1つの「スピーカーユニット」にあてがう接続法のことを指す。
で、このような接続法を実行する場合には、「外部パワーアンプ」の前段に「プロセッサー」が置かれることとなる。そしてそれにてあらかじめ音楽信号を帯域分割した上で、分割した各信号を個別に「外部パワーアンプ」の各chに入力し、そし
facts: なお「マルチアンプ接続」とは、「外部パワーアンプ」の1chずつの出力を1つ1つの「スピーカーユニット」にあてがう接続法のことを指す。
こうすることで得られる利点は主には2つある。
1つは「スピーカー」の駆動力が上がることだ。
そしてもう1つは、詳細なサウンドチューニングを行えることだ。
「フロント2ウェイ」を鳴らすときには「4chパワーアンプ」の1台使いが基本に！
ではその具体例を、フロントスピーカーが「セパレート2ウェイ」の場合を例に紹介していこう。
基本となるのは、「4chパワーアンプ」×1台にてシステムを組むやり方だ。
その1chずつの出力を左右の「ツイーター」と左右の「ミッドウーファー」とに接続すれば、各「スピーカーユニット」をイコールコンディションにてドライブできる。
そして用意する「外部パワーアンプ」は1台で済むので、インストールの手間がかかりにくくスペースも取りにくい。
または、「2chパワーアンプ」×2台にてシステムを組むのもアリだ。
「2chパワーアンプ」には音質性能が追求されたハイエンドモデルがさまざまあるので、音にこだわったシステム作りを楽しめる。
なお「2chパワーアンプ」を2台使う場合、同一モデルにてシステムを組むのが基本となるが、異なるモデルを用意するのも1つの手だ。
2台の「2chパワーアンプ」を“左右使い”するのも１つの作戦！
そして「2chパワーアンプ」を2台使う場合には、それらを「左右使い」するというやり方も選択肢の1つとして浮上する。

facts: LIXILは、2026年11月9日から20日にかけてトルコ共和国・アンタルヤで開催される国連気候変動枠組条約第31回締約国会議（COP31）において、環境省主催「ジャパン・パビリオン」に出展する。

2024年のCOP29では同パビリオン内のセミナー登壇にとどまっていたが、展示出展は今回が初めてとなる。
LIXILは「CO2ゼロと循環型の暮らし」を掲げる「LIXIL環境ビジョン2050」の実現に向け、主要素材であるアルミとプラスチックのリサイクルを推進している。

COP31の開催地であるトルコでは、発生するプラスチック廃棄物のうちリサイクルされるのはわずか6%にすぎず、残りは埋め立てや野外投棄されているとされる。

偽装をほぼ取り払った車体には、高性能モデル専用のパーツが確認できる。2027年の市場投入に向け、開発は最終段階に入っているとみられる。
◆4本出しマフラーを装着、R専用デザインが明らかに
VW TロックR 次期型のプロトタイプ『Tロック』は、VWの主力ハッチバック『ゴルフ』と基本コンポーネントを共有するコンパクトSUVだ。2025年に発表された第2世代モデルでは、デザインやプラットフォームを刷新し、電動化技術も採用している。その最上位に位置する高性能仕様が、今回捉えられたTロックRだ。
最新のプロトタイプは、ボディの大部分から偽装が取り払われ、量産型に近い姿を見せている。フロントバンパー左右のエアインテーク周辺には白いラッピングが
facts: 2027年の市場投入に向け、開発は最終段階に入っているとみられる。
◆4本出しマフラーを装着、R専用デザインが明らかに
2025年に発表された第2世代モデルでは、デザインやプラットフォームを刷新し、電動化技術も採用している。
新型は20インチホイールと幅245mmの高性能タイヤを採用し、従来型より接地性能を高める見込みだ。
VW TロックR 次期型のプロトタイプリアの特徴は、左右2本ずつ配置された4本出しマフラーだ。
◆最高出力333ps級、ゴルフRと共通のエンジン搭載か
ベースとなる第2世代Tロックは、VWグループの「MQB Evo」プラットフォームを採用。
VW TロックR 次期型のプロトタイプエンジンは、ゴルフRと技術的に共通する2.0L直列4気筒ターボを搭載する見込みだ。
現行ゴルフRは最高出力333ps、最大トルク420Nmを発揮しており、新型TロックRも同等の最高出力になるだろう。
さらに、48Vマイルドハイブリッドシステムが組み合わされる可能性もある。
トランスミッションは7速デュアルクラッチ式AT、駆動方式はVWの4WDシステム「4MOTION」となる見込みだ。
◆2027年の市場投入が有力、日本導入は未発表
量産開始は2027年10月との情報があり、欧州市場では同年中の発売が有力視されている。
コンパクトSUVの実用性に、ゴルフR譲りの333ps級ターボエンジンと高度な4WDシステムを組み合わせるとみられる新型TロックR。

items.title: フォルビアと長城汽車、グローバル戦略協力協定を締結…次世代モビリティを加速
items.summary:
自動車部品大手のフォルビアと中国の自動車メーカーの長城汽車は、グローバル戦略協力枠組み協定を締結したと発表した。
両社はこれまでも中国国内で協力関係を築いてきたが、今回の協定によりその連携を中国以外の主要国際市場へと拡大する。対象分野はイノベーション、生産における卓越性、サプライチェーンの強靭化、サステナビリティ、そして人材育成と多岐にわたる。
フォルビアはシーティング（座席）、クリーンモビリティ、エレクトロニクス、ライティングなど幅広い製品ラインで技術力と世界的な生産基盤を持つ。今回の協定では、こうしたフォルビアの強みを活かして長城汽車の国際展開を支援するとともに、より安全でスマート、かつ持続可能なモビリティソリューションの開発を世界規模で加速させる。

items.title: ヨコオ、世界最小スプリングコネクターなど欧州向け製品を披露へ…electronica 2026
items.summary:
ヨコオは、2026年11月10日（火）から13日（金）までの4日間、ドイツ・ミュンヘンの「メッセ・ミュンヘン」で開催される世界最大級の電気・電子部品の国際展示会「electronica 2026」に出展する。同社にとっては2024年に続き5回目の出展となる。
本展示会は「Empowering the All Electric Society：持続可能な完全電化社会の推進」をテーマに掲げ、半導体、パワーエレクトロニクス、電子部品、ワイヤレス通信、センサーなど幅広い分野の製品が集結する。世界中のエレクトロニクス業界関係者が来場し、最先端技術や市場トレンドを発信する場として高い評価を得ており、各国の主要メーカーやサプライヤーによる商談・ビジネス創出の機会としても注目されている。
ヨコオのブースでは、さまざまな製品を展示する予定だ。
■小型電源コネクター
欧州で進むバッテリー着脱規制への対応を見据
facts: ヨコオは、2026年11月10日（火）から13日（金）までの4日間、ドイツ・ミュンヘンの「メッセ・ミュンヘン」で開催される世界最大級の電気・電子部品の国際展示会「electronica 2026」に出展する。
同社にとっては2024年に続き5回目の出展となる。
直径わずか0.35mmのスプリングコネクターで、微細精密加工技術を生かして開発された。
5G・6Gなどの次世代通信の発展において重要な役割を果たすと同社は考えている。
ヨコオは本展示会を通じて、創業以来100年以上にわたり培ってきた技術力と提案力・カスタマイズ力を強みに、電子機器事業における認知度の向上と新規顧客の開拓を目指す。

items.title: 三菱倉庫、阪急阪神エクスプレスの全株式を取得へ…完全子会社化で国際輸送を強化
items.summary:
三菱倉庫は、阪急阪神ホールディングスと株式譲渡契約を締結し、阪急阪神エクスプレスの全株式を取得して連結子会社化することを決定したと発表した。
取得価額は阪急阪神エクスプレスの普通株式が1201億1000万円、アドバイザリー費用等の概算額が12億2700万円で、合計概算額は1213億3700万円となる。株式譲渡の実行は2026年度第4四半期を目途としており、関係当局の許認可等の取得を条件としている。
■取得の背景と狙い
三菱倉庫は倉庫、国際輸送、港湾運送、不動産事業を中核に国内外で事業を展開している。2025年度を初年度とする「経営計画［2025-2030］」では「MLC2030ビジョン」として、トータルロジスティクスと街づくりを世界で展開し、非連続な成長を実現することを掲げている。

items.title: スバル『サンバーバン』一部改良、燃費16.6km/リットルに向上…115万5000円から
items.summary:
SUBARU(スバル)は11月5日、軽商用バン『サンバーバン』の一部改良モデルを発表した。
サンバーバンは、広い荷室や快適な室内など商用車に求められる高い実用性を追求し、プロのニーズにも応えるモデルだ。なお、同車はダイハツ工業からのOEM供給を受けている。
今回の一部改良では、車両制御を見直すことで燃費性能を向上させた。WLTCモードで16.6km/Lを達成している。この燃費値は「VBクリーン」および「VB」「トランスポーター」「VC」のCVT搭載モデルに適用されるもので、それ以外のグレードはWLTCモードで15.5km/Lとなる。
WLTCモードとは、市街地・郊外・高速道路の各走行モードを平均的な使用時間配分で構成した国際的な走行モードだ。
グレード構成は「VB」「VBクリーン」「トランスポーター」「VC」「VCターボ」「ディアス」の6種類。エンジンは660ccで、VCターボのみ660c
facts: SUBARU(スバル)は11月5日、軽商用バン『サンバーバン』の一部改良モデルを発表した。
WLTCモードで16.6km/Lを達成している。
この燃費値は「VBクリーン」および「VB」「トランスポーター」「VC」のCVT搭載モデルに適用されるもので、それ以外のグレードはWLTCモードで15.5km/Lとなる。
グレード構成は「VB」「VBクリーン」「トランスポーター」「VC」「VCターボ」「ディアス」の6種類。
エンジンは660ccで、VCターボのみ660ccターボを搭載する。
変速機は5MTまたはCVT、駆動方式は2WDまたは4WDから選択できる。
メーカー希望小売価格（消費税10%込み）は、VB（5MT・2WD）の115万5000円から、ディアス（CVT・4WD）の206万8000円まで。
ボディカラーはホワイトIII、シャイニングホワイト・パール、ブライトシルバー・メタリック、ブラック・マイカメタリック、トニコオレンジ・メタリック、オフビートカーキ・メタリック、レーザーブルークリスタルシャインの7色を設定する。
販売計画は月200台を見込んでいる。

items.title: 日本精工の高負荷駆動用ボールねじ「HTF-SRM」、「超モノづくり部品大賞」機械・ロボット部品賞を受賞

items.title: フェアウェイを自動運転ゴルフカートが行く！…今週のビジネス記事ランキング
items.summary:
10月29～11月4日に公開された有料会員記事の記事について、アクセス数を元に独自ポイントで集計したランキングです。ビジネスパーソンが注目したのは「フェアウェイに乗り入れできる自動運転ゴルフカート」。プレーを想定した実証実験が始まりました。
楽天グループが運営するゴルフ場予約サイト「楽天GORA」（ゴーラ）は、フェアウェイに乗り入れできる自動運転ゴルフカートのサービス化に向け、日本で先駆けとなるゴルフプレーを想定した実証実験を開始した。実証実験は、千葉県香取郡東庄町にある「東庄ゴルフ倶楽部」の全18ホールで実施。

facts: 10月29～11月4日に公開された有料会員記事の記事について、アクセス数を元に独自ポイントで集計したランキングです。
実証実験は、千葉県香取郡東庄町にある「東庄ゴルフ倶楽部」の全18ホールで実施。
ホンダ関連拠点の認定は、2023年10月のモビリティリゾートもてぎ（栃木県芳賀郡茂木町）、2024年9月の埼玉製作所 完成車工場（埼玉県大里郡寄居町）に続き3件目で、本田技術研究所の研究開発拠点としては初めてとなる。
UBEグループの機械事業の中核会社であるUBEマシナリーは、トヨタ自動車より型締力9000tのダイカストマシンを受注し、納入を完了したと発表した。
三菱自動車は10月29日、新型『パジェロ』の日本での発売を正式に発表した。
フラッグシップSUVとして進化した新型は、上質さや快適性を備えながら 2.4リットルクリーンディーゼルターボエンジンと8速AT、そして三菱独自の車両運動統合制御システム「S-AWC」や「スーパーセレクト4WD-II」などを搭載し、走行性能も大幅に高められたという。

facts: メルセデス・ベンツ日本は11月5日、全国のメルセデス・ベンツ サーティファイドカーネットワークで販売する認定中古電気自動車（EV）を対象に、高電圧バッテリーの残存性能をユーザーに案内する運用を開始した。

items.title: Janus Electric secures battery supply deal for its battery-swap semi truck
items.summary: Australian conversion specialists Janus Electric have been celebrating a growing slate of orders for their Class 8 electric truck conversions, which ditch diesel in favor of advanced battery-swap electric power – but exactly how they’d deliver all those trucks was still a question. Now, we have an answer: Electrovaya will supply the batteries . more…
facts: Australian conversion specialists Janus Electric have been celebrating a growing slate of orders for their Class 8 electric truck conversions, which ditch diesel in favor of advanced battery-swap electric power – but exactly how they’d deliver all those trucks was still a question.
The concept of dropping an electric power unit into a Class 8 semi makes perfect sense, as most of these trucks are built as gliders.
Janus’ reservation book crept past 70 units this past summer, helped along in part by California’s HVIP Program and the US EPA’s Diesel Emission Reduction Act (DERA) Grants.

items.title: BYD車両展示キャラバン、全国のコジマ14店舗で開催へ…11月7日から
items.summary:
BYD Auto Japan（BAJ）は、11月7日（土）から全国のコジマ店舗で、「BYD車両展示キャラバン」を順次開催する。
軽EVの「RACCO」や、BYD独自のスーパーハイブリッド技術を搭載するPHEV「SEALION 6」、大幅改良したEV「ATTO 3 EX」などの最新モデルを展示する。来場者は実車でデザインや室内空間、使い勝手を確認できる。
車両展示に加え、自宅充電設備の設置工事や費用の目安、導入までの流れについて相談できる。また、車両に蓄えた電力を家庭で活用するV2H（Vehicle to Home）機器の導入や活用方法についても相談に応じる。
開催は店舗・日程により異なる。特設サイトで詳細を確認するよう案内している。なお、展示内容や日程は予告なく変更となる場合がある。

items.title: 奥田碩さんを偲ぶ「感謝の会」麻生太郎元首相やトヨタOBらが献花［新聞ウォッチ］
items.summary:
トヨタ自動車の社長、会長や経団連会長を歴任し、今年8月8日に93歳で亡くなった奥田碩さんを偲ぶ「感謝の会」が11月5日午前、東京・千代田区丸の内の「東京会館」で開かれた。
麻生太郎元首相（自民党副総裁）や玉木雄一郎・国民民主党代表ら招待された政財界の関係者ら約1000人が参列し、白菊の花に彩る祭壇に献花して故人との別れを惜しんだ。
きょうの各紙にも「トヨタ一転営業増益」を伝える中間決算の片隅に「奥田さん追悼の感謝の会、政財界1000人参列」などと取り上げているが、事前の告知のほか、会場での写真撮影や取材も“規制”されるという一風変わった“お別れの会”でもあった。
一般の企業では、多大な功績を残した社長や会長経験者が亡くなられた場合、会社主催の「お別れの会」を執り行うケースも少なくないが、奥田さんを追悼する感謝の会では、出身母体のトヨタと経団連が協力して主催は遺族。生前故人と親交の深かった人

items.title: E-quipment highlight: Jungheinrich launches new forklift for Asian markets
items.summary: Like many equipment brands, German forklift maker Jungheinrich has been struggling to crack the Asian industrial markets – but the company is set to change all that with the launch of a new line of 1.6- to 3-ton class electric forklifts designed specifically to navigate the region’s tight warehouses and factories. more…
facts: Like many equipment brands, German forklift maker Jungheinrich has been struggling to crack the Asian industrial markets – but the company is set to change all that with the launch of a new line of 1.6- to 3-ton class electric forklifts designed specifically to navigate the region’s tight warehouses and factories.

Forklift buyers can choose between two performance packages, prioritizing energy efficiency for everyday material handling or more driving and lifting muscle for more demanding, high-throughput operations.

items.title: アイシンの営業利益が16.3％減、通期営業利益予想を下方修正 中間決算
items.summary:
アイシンは10月29日、2027年3月期中間決算（2026年4～9月）を発表した。売上収益は前年同期比7.3％増の2兆6531億円、営業利益は同16.3％減の804億円と増収減益だった。円安が売上収益を押し上げたいっぽう、資材価格の高騰や熊本地震の影響などが利益を圧迫した。
税引前利益は同17.4％減の879億円、親会社の所有者に帰属する中間利益は同28.9％減の496億円。営業利益率は前年同期の3.9％から3.0％に低下した。
パワートレインユニットの販売台数は、前年同期比3.8％減の497万台だった。いっぽう、ハイブリッド車向けユニットと電動駆動装置「eアクスル」を合わせた電動ユニットは、同39.5％増の168万台に拡大した。

Segway is using its CTB (cell-to-body) battery integration to help improve structural rigidity and battery packaging, with the company targeting nearly 200 km (124 miles) of range.

items.title: Kia EV2 Earth: Two weeks with Kia’s compact range marvel
items.summary: A longstanding rule of thumb in electromobility has been that you either get long range or compact dimensions - you can't have both, especially not at an attractive price. After all, the battery has to fit somewhere. Kia wants to change that with its new EV2. This 4.06-meter-long compact car is available with an optional 61-kWh battery and a starting price tag of €26,600. We tested it for two week
facts: Kia EV2 Earth: Two weeks with Kia’s compact range marvel
But while other manufacturers often promise affordable and practical electric vehicles only for the future, Kia is already taking the next step in electrifying its fleet with the EV2.
Visually, the EV2 holds no surprises – it predictably aligns with its larger siblings, the EV3 to EV9.
The sharp lines give the EV2 a boxy appearance, almost like a removal van.
Yet, the EV2 is not overly aggressive; it’s simply a charming compact car that’s easier to take seriously than many other models in its class.
The display combination and steering wheel are the same as those found in high-end models like the EV6 and EV9.

items.title: Ford's Top-Spec Fathom Will Cost Under $40,000
items.summary: The prices of gas and new cars are equally out of control these days, but Ford is looking to correct both with its modestly priced new truck.
facts: Ford's Top-Spec Fathom Will Cost Under $40,000
Ford's confirmation that the new Fathom electric truck would start at under $30,000 has already stirred up enthusiasm for buyers looking for an affordable truck.
Not according to one Ford executive, who just told reporters that even the most luxurious Fathom trim would come in below $40,000.

The Fathom lineup starts at $29,945 including $1,595 destination, and it will top out in "the high $30,000 range," Andrew Frick, head of the Blue Oval's Ford Model e electric division, told the Detroit Free Press.

items.title: New Jersey is putting 10 MW of community solar on warehouse roofs
items.summary: Warehouse roofs are prime real estate for solar, and Faropoint is putting more of that underused space to work in New Jersey. The industrial property owner has started construction on the first of 16 community solar projects totaling more than 10 megawatts (MW). more…
facts: The industrial property owner has started construction on the first of 16 community solar projects totaling more than 10 megawatts (MW).
First up is a 1.6 MW rooftop array at 19-05 Nevins Road in Fair Lawn.
Another 15 projects, totaling about 8.5 MW, have been accepted into New Jersey’s Community Solar Energy Program, and nine are already cleared to start construction.
Faropoint and its independent solar adviser, SolarKal, expect the 16 projects to generate around 12.7 million kilowatt-hours (kWh) of electricity annually once they’re operating.
They estimate the portfolio will avoid about 8,500 metric tons of carbon dioxide emissions a year.
New Jersey’s program requires a minimum of 51%.

items.title: UK car sales: third of buyers go electric but Jaecoo 7 claims top spot
items.summary: Car makers approaching ZEV mandate targets after high fuel prices boost EV sales – but ICE car claims crown Electric car registrations in October reached their highest share of total UK sales this year, at almost 33%, as the overall market continued to grow. The Skoda Enyaq was the biggest electric seller in the month, followed by the Mini Countryman , according to figures from the Society of Moto
facts: Electric car registrations in October reached their highest share of total UK sales this year, at almost 33%, as the overall market continued to grow.
The Jaecoo 7 was the UK’s top seller for the second consecutive month in October, with 3412 sales, closely followed the Ford Puma, which remains the UK’s overall best-seller for the year.
Volkswagen remained the UK’s favourite brand, with a market share of 9.0% in the month, while BMW overtook Audi for second spot with a 5.6% share.
Sales overall grew 5.4% to 152,730.
Chinese brands again shone in October, but their combined market share of 21.3% was lower than for the month of September, when it stood at a record 23.3%.

items.title: The Mazdaspeed3 Isn't Coming Back. Mazda Says 'It's Rumors'
items.summary: Mazda Australia’s managing director says reports of a new performance hatchback are just rumors.
facts: The Mazdaspeed3 Isn't Coming Back.
The Mazdaspeed3 lasted just two generations over six model years, but it left a lasting mark on enthusiasts.

A direct competitor to the Ford Focus ST, Honda Civic Si, and Volkswagen Golf GTI, the Mazdaspeed3 was a proper hot hatch that is unlikely to return to Mazda’s lineup anytime soon, despite the speculation.
It would supposedly have a turbocharged engine producing more than 295 horsepower, but that appears to be untrue.
In an interview with Australia's Drive, Vinesh Bhindi, Mazda Australia’s managing director, squashed any notion that Mazda is readying a hotter Mazda3.

items.title: Kia EV7 and H2-Carnival in the works
items.summary: Kia is apparently planning a battery-electric EV7 and a hydrogen-powered van from the Carnival series, which is available in certain markets. This is according to a Korean portal citing an internal company document that lists production plans for the coming years.
facts: Kia EV7 and H2-Carnival in the works
The Korean Car Blog reports that a mid-sized battery-electric SUV, the EV7, is set to enter production at Kia’s Gwangju plant starting in 2028.
Additionally, by 2029, Kia reportedly plans to introduce a hydrogen-powered version of its Carnival van, to be manufactured at the Gwangmyeong plant.
If confirmed, the H2-Carnival would mark Kia’s first series-production model with a hydrogen fuel cell powertrain.
The presumed EV7 is described only as a mid-sized SUV, with production scheduled to begin in Gwangju in 2028.
However, this aligns with reports that sister company Hyundai is planning an Ioniq 7.

items.title: The New BMW Alpina 7-Series Will Let You Cruise Down The Autobahn At Over 186 MPH
items.summary: As shown in recent testing at Italy's Nardo circuit, the new BMW Alpina 7-Series will be very comfortable with high-speed autobahn cruising.
facts: The New BMW Alpina 7-Series Will Let You Cruise Down The Autobahn At Over 186 MPH
Courtesy of a potent V8 powertrain

Just days after our spy photographers snapped the new BMW Alpina 7-Series testing at the Nürburgring, and shortly after BMW released a mysterious teaser image, the German brand has given the world insight into the luxury sedan's testing regime.
BMW Alpina is testing the new car at Italy's famous 7.8-mile high-speed Nardo circuit, and it's not going easy on the fancy 7-Series.
BMW describes it as a 'distance-shrinking machine', and that makes sense, as it can comfortably sit at speeds over 186 mph.
Alpina's flagship sedan will have a powerful V8

items.title: Toyota updates the 2027 RAV4 PHEV with an NACS port and up to 52 miles of EV range
items.summary: The 2027 Toyota RAV4 is bringing a few major updates, including an added NACS charge port on all plug-in hybrid (PHEV) models. more…
facts: The 2027 Toyota RAV4 is bringing a few major updates, including an added NACS charge port on all plug-in hybrid (PHEV) models.
2027 Toyota RAV4 prices and updates
The RAV4 was Toyota’s best-selling nameplate in the US last year and consistently ranks among America’s most popular vehicles alongside the Ford F-Series and Chevrolet Silverado.
For the 2027 model year, Toyota added several notable upgrades.
The 2027 Toyota RAV4 will be available with hybrid (HEV) and plug-in hybrid (PHEV) powertrains, with available front- or all-wheel drive (AWD).
The biggest change is that all 2027 RAV4 PHEV models now have a built-in NACS charge port with Level 3 DC fast-charging capabilities.

items.title: The 2027 Chevrolet Silverado's New V8s Are Great, But The Tech Is The Bigger Story
items.summary: The biggest updates to the 2027 Chevrolet Silverado aren't the new engines (which are great), but the new technology on board.
facts: The 2027 Chevrolet Silverado's New V8s Are Great, But The Tech Is The Bigger Story
Who doesn't love a V8 in a pickup truck?

As four-cylinders and V-6s continue to invade the full-size truck market, Chevy is appealing to tried-and-true truck lovers with two all-new V8 engine options under the hood of the 2027 Chevrolet Silverado.
The Silverado's outgoing 5.3-liter V8 is being replaced with a new 5.7-liter unit — a nostalgic 350 cubic inches.
Paired with the company's 10-speed automatic, the "regular" Silverado 1500 makes 402 hp and 428 lb-ft of torque.
That's enough oomph to accelerate briskly off the line and still hit a maximum towing capacity of 13,700 pounds.

items.title: "Depressing yet exciting": When Brits were invited on Soviet road trips
items.summary: Tourist coaches in Red Square, Moscow, in 1967 | Credit: Getty Images Amazingly, the USSR lifted the Iron Curtain to foreign drivers in the '50s and '60s – but they did keep a close eye… The common perception of the Cold War period is of two isolated worlds, divided by an unmoving, impenetrable Iron Curtain. Yet in fact communist nations did accept tourism from their capitalist rivals – encouraged
facts: Tourist coaches in Red Square, Moscow, in 1967 | Credit: Getty Images Amazingly, the USSR lifted the Iron Curtain to foreign drivers in the '50s and '60s – but they did keep a close eye… The common perception of the Cold War period is of two isolated worlds, divided by an unmoving, impenetrable Iron Curtain.
And while the prospect would have scared many, Autocar found in 1957 that “a road journey through the USSR may be undertaken without apprehension”.
Having successfully run Arctic cruises and opened a London office, in 1935 Intourist began offering motor tours on which Brits could drive their own cars.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz starts assembling electric GLC in India
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz has begun assembling the electric GLC from imported knocked-down kits at its plant in Chakan, near Pune in the Indian state of Maharashtra. Chakan is the second site for assembling the new EV from kits, after Thailand's Thonburi Automotive Assembly Plant (TAAP), and overall its fourth production site worldwide.
facts: The German luxury carmaker assembles only the top-end 400 4MATIC variant of the electric GLC in India.
It launched the model immediately after the roll-out and offers it in only one trim, AMG Line, for a price of 7.85 million rupees (approx.
€73,800 euros), excluding registration cost, insurance, and 1 per cent TCS (Tax Collected at Source).
The electric GLC is only about 2 per cent more expensive than the entry-level combustion-engined GLC, the retail prices of which start at 7.70 million rupees (~€72,400 euros).
Launched in 2016, the latter is subject to 40 per cent GST (Goods and Services Tax), while its MB.EA-M platform-based electric sibling attracts 5 per cent GST.

items.title: Can You Really Clean Old Spark Plugs And Use Them Again?
items.summary: Spark plugs cost money to replace, so can you just clean them up and reuse them?
facts: A new set of quality plugs on a Dodge Challenger with a Hemi V8 might set you back $350 in parts alone, which is not pocket change to most drivers, not when gas prices are over $4 per gallon.
Plug manufacturer NGK has a few tips to prepare your used plugs for another few thousand miles of sparking.
Wait 10 minutes, then use a wire brush to clean off any deposits before setting the gaps to the automaker's spec.
Platinum plugs fitted to cars from the 2000s as standard can last over 50,000 miles, and more modern long-life iridium versions are often good for more than 100,000.

items.title: Hyundai Is Expanding Its Alabama Engine Plant For Hybrids And Range Extenders
items.summary: With a $450 million investment in its Alabama factory, Hyundai is aiming to ramp up its production capacity of hybrid and range-extender vehicles.
facts: In fact, it's doing so with an investment of nearly $450 million in Montgomery, Alabama.
Officials celebrated the announcement on October 28, tying the production upgrades to a broader expansion of the plant's powertrain capabilities.
It'll arrive at dealers in the first half of 2027 with an expected range of more than 600 miles.
Notably, Hyundai hasn't announced a 600-mile battery-only Santa Fe.
Ultimately, the benefit of vehicles like the Genesis GV90 EREV is obvious.
At its 2026 CEO Investor Day, the automaker said North America would offer more than 10 hybrid models by 2030, since hybrids account for half the regional sales mix.

items.title: Ireland unveils new charging infrastructure strategy for 2028
items.summary: Ireland aims to further expand its charging infrastructure by the end of 2028. A new national strategy includes additional fast-charging parks along major traffic routes and more charging options in residential areas.
facts: Ireland unveils new charging infrastructure strategy for 2028
Transport Minister Darragh O’Brien first presented the National EV Infrastructure Strategy 2026–2028 on 4 November.
The strategy aims to ensure that the public charging network keeps pace with the growing number of electric vehicles and provides sufficient charging options nationwide.
According to the Department of Transport, more than 270,000 electric vehicles are now registered in Ireland, exceeding the target set in the Climate Action Plan for 2025.
Electric vehicles now account for a 26.3 per cent market share of new registrations, making them the largest powertrain group.

items.title: Electric cars are about to overtake petrol in the UK, data shows
items.summary: Battery-electric cars took 32% of the UK’s new car market in October, while petrol cars fell to just 37.2%, according to new data from the SMMT. That’s the closest the two have been. At the current pace, electric cars will outsell petrol in the UK within a year. And it could happen as soon as this December. more…
facts: Battery-electric cars took 32% of the UK’s new car market in October, while petrol cars fell to just 37.2%, according to new data from the SMMT.
October: EVs up 33%, petrol down 12%
The UK registered 152,730 new cars in October, up 5.4% year-over-year and the 11th straight month of growth for the overall market.
BEV registrations jumped 32.7% to 48,858 units, and plug-in hybrids rose 30.1% to 22,898.
Meanwhile, petrol fell 11.6% to 56,876 units, diesel dropped 15.9%, and even conventional hybrids were down 5%.
Through the first 10 months of the year, the UK has now registered 503,805 BEVs, up 30.4%, for a 26.6% market share.

items.title: Car makers win reprieve as EU eases 2035 emissions rules
items.summary: Credit: Getty Images Brussels lowers CO2 reduction targets from 100% to 87.5%, paving way for combustion cars to remain on sale The EU will allow more ICE cars to be sold after 2035 after its Environment Committee approved a proposal to lower CO2 reduction targets to 87.5%, down from 100%. The committee also voted in favour of a proposal to allow “vehicles running exclusively on eligible fuels” (V
facts: The EU will allow more ICE cars to be sold after 2035 after its Environment Committee approved a proposal to lower CO2 reduction targets to 87.5%, down from 100%.
The vote on 4 November was given a cautious welcome by European car industry body the ACEA, which acknowledged the “pragmatic” approach and extra flexibility.
European car makers have been pushing to allow more ICE car sales after 2035 as they struggle to lower the cost of EV batteries.
The 87.5% figure refers to the reduction from the 2021 baseline target and now gives car makers room to sell more combustion-engine models.

items.title: LG Energy Solution launches battery research competition
items.summary: LG Energy Solution launches the Battery Innovation Contest 2026. Universities and research institutions worldwide can submit proposals for new battery technologies until December 6. The focus includes battery materials, battery management, and AI.
facts: Applications have been accepted since 29 October via the company’s in-house innovation platform, BRIDGE.
LGES has funded around 50 research projects since 2017
Since the competition’s launch in 2017, LG Energy Solution has supported around 50 research projects, according to the company.
The company also highlights research into a long-life solid-state battery that can operate at room temperature, with results published in the journal Science in 2019.
The South Korean manufacturer is reportedly set to supply novel 46100 cylindrical cells for future Mercedes-Benz electric vehicles.
Production could begin preparations in 2027, with deliveries scheduled to start in 2028.

items.title: PPC Blue to install fast chargers on Romanian motorway
items.summary: Greek charging provider PPC Blue continues to expand in Romania, and is now installing and operating 30 fast-charging points along Romanian highway A7 in cooperation with Romanian oil company Oscar Downstream. Nearly half of the charging points will be suitable for electric trucks and buses.
facts: This is already the third time this year that we are reporting on PPC Blue’s expansion plans: In May, the subsidiary of Greece’s power utility Public Power Corporation (PPC) announced plans to install 106 fast and ultra-fast charging points at 34 strategic locations along key European transport corridors in Romania and Greece.
In June, this was followed by a partnership with the Romanian DIY chain Dedeman: The plan is to install more than 600 charging points at Dedeman’s stores and logistics centres across the country.
30-year service area concession

items.title: Fraunhofer develops tool for battery recycling
items.summary: Fraunhofer FFB and RWTH Aachen University have developed an evaluation model for the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. It allows different processes to be compared in terms of their costs and CO₂ emissions.
facts: Fraunhofer develops tool for battery recycling
According to the findings, recycling lithium-ion batteries in Europe under the examined conditions currently results in an average loss of around €1.90 per kilogram of battery pack.
To capture these relationships, the tool divides the entire recycling chain into individual areas, process steps and technologies using a modular principle.
The tool is based on a database containing information about individual process steps.
Users can specify parameters such as material throughput and the composition of the batteries to be recycled, then compile customised process chains.

items.title: BYD launches second-gen Seal 07 in China with lower prices and longer range
items.summary: The second-generation BYD Seal 07 features a larger body and a lower starting price of 139,900 yuan ($20,830). For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - The second-generation BYD Seal 07 features a larger body and a lower starting price of 139,900 yuan ($20,830).
- The all-electric version's range increases to 775 kilometers, while the plug-in hybrid's electric range reaches 330 kilometers.
BYD (HKEX: 1211) launched the second-generation Seal 07 in China on Thursday, refreshing both the all-electric and plug-in hybrid versions with lower starting prices and longer range.
The new model is available in 5 trims, with official guide prices ranging from 139,900 yuan ($20,830) to 172,900 yuan, comprising 2 DM-i plug-in hybrid variants and 3 all-electric variants.

items.title: Tesla opens new engineering centre in Berlin-Köpenick
items.summary: Tesla has opened its new development center in Berlin-Köpenick. Engineers and technicians will work there on new vehicles, engines, and materials, as well as research and testing. The location will bring together 250 employees who previously worked at various sites.
facts: The US electric vehicle manufacturer renovated an old factory complex covering approximately 20,000 square metres for this purpose.
According to the news portal RBB24, these include safety tests on vehicle components and tests on battery cells, which will be carried out in a large hall at the centre.
Tesla states that the site brings together four development locations on a single campus with 30 different laboratories.
Initially, the Berlin Tesla Engineering Centre will provide a workplace for around 250 engineers and technicians.

items.title: The Lincoln Aviator PHEV May Have Died In America, But It’s Coming Back In China
items.summary: China's MIIT has exposed the Lincoln Aviator EX8, a Changan-made PHEV made just for China.
facts: China's MIIT has exposed the Lincoln Aviator EX8, a Changan-made PHEV made just for China.
- The Lincoln Aviator EX8 is a PHEV model made by Lincoln's Chinese joint venture partner, Changan.
- It shares nothing in common with the Lincoln Aviator PHEV, which was discontinued for 2024.
- Combustion power for the Aviator EX8 comes from a Changan-made 1.5-liter turbocharged engine.
While the Lincoln Aviator PHEV died in 2024 for most of the world, its nameplate will carry on in China.
This week, China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) exposed homologation details of Lincoln’s all-new PHEV crossover, the Lincoln Aviator EX8.

items.title: GM Recalls 67,000 Chevy Blazer EVs And Cadillac Lyriqs Over Dangerous Brake Issue
items.summary: Certain Chevrolet Blazer EV and Cadillac models face low-speed brake loss, with owners getting a free software update through over-the-air or dealers.
facts: GM Recalls 67,000 Chevy Blazer EVs And Cadillac Lyriqs Over Dangerous Brake Issue
General Motors is recalling 67,380 Chevrolet Blazer EVs and Cadillac Lyriqs, Vistiqs, and Celestiqs over a software defect that can briefly kill the brakes.
2024 Chevrolet Blazer EV SS
Cadillac's Lyriq numbers break down by year: 474 from 2023, 22,819 from 2024, 11,926 from 2025, 9,322 from 2026, and 44 early 2027 units.
The three-row Vistiq adds 13,627 from 2026 and 5,175 from 2027, while the flagship Celestiq contributes just 51 cars from 2025 and 31 from 2026.
NHTSA's site lets anyone search a VIN directly, and GM's own notification will not go out until December 14, so checking now saves weeks of wondering.

items.title: Switzerland to align CO2 targets for vans and trucks with EU standards
items.summary: The Swiss Federal Council wants to align the CO2 requirements for newly registered trucks and vans with the EU targets. While this would relax the CO2 limits for light commercial vehicles starting in 2030, the regulations for trucks are to be tightened.
facts: Switzerland to align CO2 targets for vans and trucks with EU standards
The Swiss Federal Council is driving the alignment of climate targets in transport with EU standards.
The government has now sent the corresponding draft revisions for the CO2 Act and the Energy Act into the official consultation procedure (known as the Vernehmlassung).
The aim is to align the requirements for new vehicles from 2030 with the EU Commission’s forthcoming Auto Package.

However, requirements for the period from 2035 onwards are explicitly not part of this legislative package – it thus excludes the EU discussion about a “phase-out of the phase-out of combustion engines”.

items.title: VW And Skoda EV Owners Have Waited Years For Battery Preconditioning. It's Finally Coming
items.summary: The two automakers are launching an over-the-air software update for the oldest Enyaq, ID.4, and ID.5 EVs on the road.
facts: The two automakers are launching an over-the-air software update for the oldest Enyaq, ID.4, and ID.5 EVs on the road.
- Volkswagen and Skoda are adding a much-needed battery pre-heating feature to the oldest ID.4, ID.5, and Enyaq EVs on the road.
- Over 200,000 cars will get an over-the-air software update starting in the second half of November, 2027.

The first Volkswagen ID.4 and Skoda Enyaq electric crossovers to roll off the assembly lines back in 2020 marked a big step for the two automakers, but owners quickly faced an uncomfortable truth: their high-voltage batteries could not be preconditioned for fast charging, which resulted in longer-than-expected charging times during cold weather.

items.title: Mercedes-Geely venture Smart expands #2 roll-out in China with Premium trim
items.summary: The Smart #2 Premium has launched in China with a limited-time starting price of 99,900 yuan ($14,880) after incentives. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - The Smart #2 Premium has launched in China with a limited-time starting price of 99,900 yuan ($14,880) after incentives.
- The 2-seater measures 2,751 mm in length and offers a CLTC range of up to 410 km.
Smart launched the Smart #2 Premium in China on Thursday with a limited-time starting price of 99,900 yuan ($14,880) after incentives.
The Premium trim has a list price of 102,900 yuan.
Launch benefits include a 3,000 yuan purchase incentive.
Smart is a joint venture brand between Mercedes-Benz and Geely Auto (HKEX: 0175).
The #2 is the all-electric successor to the classic ForTwo 2-seat city car.
The launch continues the #2's market roll-out.

items.title: DeepWay electric semi arrives in New Zealand, and gets a new name
items.summary: New Zealand’s Foodstuffs North Island Limited has given its latest electric semi truck an electrifying new identity, courtesy of a second-grade student at a local elementary school. more…
facts: The winning name came from Year 2 (read: second grade) student named Madison, who beat out suggestions including Buzzy Bee, Lightning, and Bolt.

In its first few months on the road, Evie’s travelled nearly 45,000 kilometers (~28,000 miles) and avoided more than 81,000 kg of harmful carbon emissions – which the company claims is roughly equivalent to taking 35 ICE cars off the road for a full year.

items.title: Are Europe’s truck manufacturers losing their home market?
items.summary: European commercial vehicle manufacturers now offer a wide range of electric trucks. However, new competitors from China and other regions are increasingly pressuring the established industry - not necessarily with better technology, but with lower prices. In a video interview with electrive, Johanna Braun from Transport & Environment (T&E) explains why she considers the demand for relaxing Europe
facts: For Johanna Braun, Policy Manager for E-Mobility Freight & Infrastructure at the environmental organisation Transport & Environment (T&E), this growing competition serves as a warning signal to the European industry.
Over a five-year period, accounting for purchase and operation, the vehicles from new competitors are around 10 per cent cheaper.

Additionally, there are differing production strategies: while European manufacturers traditionally focus on individually configured commercial vehicles, some new suppliers are placing greater emphasis on standardised models and correspondingly more efficient mass production.

items.title: BMW Creates One-Off M3 Tribute To A Motorsport Legend
items.summary: This unique BMW M3 display car honors Alex Zanardi with M-inspired livery, pineapple graphics, and an E30 Sport Evolution–influenced interior.
facts: BMW Creates One-Off M3 Tribute To A Motorsport Legend
This unique BMW M3 display car honors Alex Zanardi with M-inspired livery, pineapple graphics, and an E30 Sport Evolution–influenced interior.
BMW Italia has put a one-off M3 on display at EICMA 2026, and it has nothing to do with motorcycles.
The car sits in Hall 14 at the BMW Motorrad stand as a tribute to Alex Zanardi, built to mark what would have been his 60th birthday.
The car, badged "Tribute to Alex Zanardi," was built with Italian design studio BorromeoDeSilva on the current M3's body.

items.title: EU Parliament: Environment Committee votes to relax CO2 rules
items.summary: Following the Industry and Transport Committee, the Environment Committee has now also voted in favour of relaxing the combustion engine phase-out. The European Parliament as a whole is expected to decide in December. The previous votes are considered an important indicator.
facts: EU Parliament: Environment Committee votes to relax CO2 rules
In the European Parliament, three key committees have now voted on a central part of the Auto Package (specifically, a regulatory draft) – with the Environment Committee joining them this week.
The result: the majority supports relaxing the CO2 rules for passenger cars and light commercial vehicles, as internally agreed upon by the so-called ‘centre platform’ in October.

This makes it increasingly clear in the European Parliament that a decision is emerging on this important aspect of the Auto Package, which aims to relax the de facto ban on new internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles in the EU from 2035.

items.title: Aniioki A9 Pro Max review: Basically an electric motorcycle that you can pedal
items.summary: There are electric bikes, there are electric motorcycles, and then there are machines like the Aniioki A9 Pro Max that plant a flag somewhere in the increasingly large no-man’s-land between the two. more…
facts: There are electric bikes, there are electric motorcycles, and then there are machines like the Aniioki A9 Pro Max that plant a flag somewhere in the increasingly large no-man’s-land between the two.
Not when we’re talking about dual motors producing up to 6,000W of peak power and speeds of around 45 mph.
The Aniioki A9 Pro Max is absolutely massive, and the spec sheet makes that abundantly clear.
The version I tested uses a pair of 2,500W direct-drive hub motors, one in each wheel, with Aniioki claiming 3,000W peak power from each motor.
That gives the bike a combined peak figure of 6,000W and up to 250 Nm of combined torque.

items.title: After Bringing Back The Evo II, HWA Is Now Reviving The AMG Hammer
items.summary: From the firm that brought you the Mercedes-Benz 190E EVO II restomod comes what appears to be a reborn version of the legendary AMG Hammer.
facts: It then ventured into the restomodding world with its limited-run, reborn 190E Evo II and is now turning its attention to a new project.
The original Hammer launched in the mid-1980s as the ultimate version of the W124 sedan.
The car, officially badged the 300E 5.6 AMG, ditched the original naturally aspirated 3.0-liter inline-6 in favor of a 5.5-liter V8.
This engine made 355 horsepower and 388 pound-feet of torque, enough for the rear-wheel-drive beast to hit 60 mph in just five seconds.
It quickly earned a nickname of 'The Hammer' and was later updated with a 6.0-liter engine making 385 hp and 420 lb-ft.
It's a true AMG icon and is perhaps the perfect next project for HWA.

items.title: Porsche Panamera Facelift Spied, But Can It Stop The Sales Slide?
items.summary: Porsche Panamera spy shots show gasoline and hybrid version of the MY28 sedans
facts: Panamera sales dropped 38% this year, but Porsche hopes a MY28 update can get it back on track
Its design philosophy evolves so slowly it makes the glaciers that formed the mountains of the Alps look fast moving.

It's why the profile of a modern 911 is almost exactly the same as the first one's 63 years ago, and why the changes to this Panamera prototype spotted testing at the Nürburgring are incredibly hard to spot.
The Panamera is Porsche's gasoline- and hybrid-powered sedan, an ICE companion to the electric Taycan, and was heavily overhauled for 2024.

items.title: Zotye's right-hand-drive Wink Y01 rolls off line, with deliveries planned for early 2027
items.summary: The new model targets overseas markets, with Zotye focusing on India and Indonesia. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - Zotye aims to sign dealer agreements in 25 countries by the end of 2026.
Zotye Auto (SZSE: 000980) said the right-hand-drive version of its Wink Y01 international model recently rolled off the production line, with mass production and deliveries planned for early 2027.

items.title: This Startup Wants To Turn Teslas Into Anything, From 11-Seat Minibuses To Pickups
items.summary: The Hoffman Badger made its debut at this year’s SEMA show, driving all the way from Wisconsin to Las Vegas.
facts: This Startup Wants To Turn Teslas Into Anything, From 11-Seat Minibuses To Pickups
Hoffman says it uses all of the hardware and software from the donor vehicle, which can be either the Model 3 or Model Y.
The startup says it can build around 100 units per year, but exact details haven’t been ironed out yet.

items.title: Renault Is Getting Into Military Vehicles With An Unmanned Off-Roader
items.summary: It's fully electric, but can also be fitted with a range extender.
facts: Renault Is Getting Into Military Vehicles With An Unmanned Off-Roader
The company best known for building everyday hatchbacks, crossovers, and electric city cars has teamed up with a Belgian defense specialist to develop an unmanned military off-roader.
The concept is expected to cover around 249 miles (400 kilometers) on a single charge, but it can go the extra mile with a range-extender combustion engine.
Renault says the Forefront can carry up to 1,000 kilograms (2,205 pounds).
Civilian applications include disaster response, civil protection, logistics, and work in hazardous environments where sending human operators would be risky.

items.title: Factory logistics with 25-metre trucks: Fendt opts for longer electric HGVs
items.summary: Agricultural machinery manufacturer Fendt recently adopted a unique approach to electrifying its in-house logistics for tractor production. Alongside its partner Ansorge, the Bavarian company is using eight electric long-haul trucks to transport tractor cabs. Other companies, such as Elflein, are now also using these 25.25-meter-long e-trucks.
facts: Factory logistics with 25-metre trucks: Fendt opts for longer electric HGVs
The Fendt brand, founded in 1930 in Marktoberdorf, Bavaria, is electrifying the transport of tractor cabs between its plants in Asbach-Bäumenheim and Marktoberdorf.

Together with Allgäu transport service provider Ansorge Logistik, Fendt has replaced its previous diesel trucks with modern electric trucks of the Mercedes-Benz eActros 600 type – specifically long versions.

Toyota's Profit Outlook Rises To $24.6 Billion
New Toyota 1.5-liter engine

items.title: The Olds Calais Was An Indy 500 Pace Car Edition With No Pace
items.summary: Circa 1985, long-gone automaker Oldsmobile created an Indy 500 pace car edition of its underpowered Calais, and one of them is now up for auction.
facts: The Olds Calais Was An Indy 500 Pace Car Edition With No Pace
For as long as there's been an Indianapolis 500, there's been an Indianapolis 500 pace car.
But it took until 1953 — 42 years after the inaugural race — for automakers to realize they could make bank by peddling replicas of the sedans, coupes and convertibles that led the field.
Some of these lookalikes, cars like the orange and white 1969 Chevy Camaro SS/RS, and the the black and silver 1978 Corvette pace car replica, are blue-chip collector classics.
Others, like this Oldsmobile Calais 500, which is up for auction through Bring a Trailer, are rarely remembered.

items.title: 【F1カメラマン熱田護の「気合いで撮る！」】第140回：いろんなことがありすぎたメキシコGP。ハースの平川選手、メルセデスのアントネッリ選手、おめでとう!!
items.summary: メキシコGP。いろんなことがありましたね。
facts: F1カメラマン熱田護の「気合いで撮る！
第140回：いろんなことがありすぎたメキシコGP。
なぜならば、F1ドライバーになるために多くのドライバーが夢見て日々努力を重ねているわけですが、平川選手もその1人。
F1レギュラードライバーのシートを得ることは、実に大変です。
今年、在籍しているハースのレースシートが1席空きました。
ドライバー人生を懸けてハンガリーGPのFP1やヘレステストに臨んだはずです。
特にこの1年はドライバー人生を懸けて臨んだわけですからね。
そこから約1か月後のメキシコで、その後の話を聞こうと思っていた土曜日に、急遽オコン選手のシートでレースに出ることが決まったわけです。
ほぼ諦めかけていたレースシートが1戦だけとはいえ、レースに出られるというのはいったいどのような心境だったのか。
きっと、目まぐるしい2日間だったのではないでしょうか。
FP1の始まる前、クルマに乗り込む前の様子。
僕の横を通り過ぎていくときに話していたのは「71ラップだから……」という小松さんの声だけ聞こえました。
日曜日、ドラパレ前の集合場所に2番目に登場の平川選手。
」ってベアマン選手に言われて歩き出す2人。
18番グリッドにマシンを止めて、エンジニアのローラさんと明るい表情で情報交換。
平川選手：苦労というより、やはり全部が初めてだったので、例えば長い71周のレースに向けて、スタート後の1コーナーでクルマへのダメージは避けたいとかがあって、序盤抑えた感じはありましたけど、1周ごとによくなって、最後に2台オーバーテイクできました。

items.title: Can Anything Stop This Giant-Tired Sherp Off-Roader? These YouTubers Find Out
items.summary: Shaun Walford and Dave tackle Whiteswan Lake and an overgrown swamp loop in Saskatchewan to test the Sherp's limits.
facts: The amphibious off-roader has a reputation for shrugging off terrain that ends most trail rides early.
Sherp Amphibious Off-Road Vehicle In Saskatchewan
The day started calmly at Whiteswan Lake, where the Sherp's amphibious design let it roll straight from dry ground into open water without pausing.
The vehicle's oversized, ultra-low-pressure tires double as flotation, helped by about 44 horsepower and a quoted top water speed of roughly 3.7 mph.
On land, the same Sherp is rated for about 25 mph and can reportedly climb a 35-degree incline.
Those numbers explain why it handles stumps and logs that would hang up a standard 4x4.

Chevrolet is giving its most expensive electric pickup a power bump for the 2027 model, not that it needed it.
The 2027 Chevrolet Silverado EV Trail Boss with the Max Range battery pack now puts down a whopping 750 horsepower and 775 pound-feet of torque, as reported by GM Authority.

That’s 25 hp more than the outgoing model, but it’s worth noting that the maximum output is only available when activating the Wide Open Watts (WOW) mode, which pushes every metric to the top for maximum acceleration, but isn’t intended for regular use.

◆スプリ
facts: 二輪車向け部品・システムを手がける大手サプライヤーのアステモ（Astemo）は、11月3日にイタリア・ミラノで開幕した世界最大級の二輪車ショー「EICMA 2026」に出展。
【詳細画像47枚】EICMA 2026に展示されたアステモの最新技術
注目は、同じスプリングのまま硬さを切り替えられる新しいサスペンション機構や、2030年の市場投入を目指す二輪車用インホイールモーターだ。
アステモがEICMA 2026で示した5つの技術トピックを紹介する。
アステモが開発した新機構は、スプリングそのものを交換することなく、サスペンションシステム全体の実効スプリングレートを2段階に切り替えられるというものだ。
「スプリングレート可変」を搭載したBMW『R 1300 R』（EICMA 2026）また、フロントフォークとリアショックの双方に適用でき、SHOWAの電子制御減衰力調整機構「EERA」と組み合わせることも可能だ。
この機構はすでにBMW『R 1300 R』および『R 1300 RS』に採用されているが、将来的には、走行モードに応じて減衰力だけでなくスプリングレートまで最適化することで、1台のバイクが持つ走行性能と快適性の幅をさらに広げることが期待される。
◆2030年の市場投入を目指す、軽量・高出力インホイールモーター
二輪車用インホイールモーターを搭載した『Ninja e-1』（EICMA 2026）電動化技術では、二輪車用インホイールモーターのプロトタイプを披露した。
アステモは2026年5月の「人とくるまのテクノロジー展」で、この二輪車用インホイールモーターを初公開。

Meet the TX1, an unusual creation that takes a fourth-generation Tacoma and gives it a heavy dose of GX 550 DNA.
Making its debut at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas, the one-off build started life as a CGI rendering by digital artist Lukemadevids.

facts: This Corvette Z06 Owner Gave It The Twin-Turbo Treatment Chevy Never Did
Late Model Racecraft’s 2027 Corvette Z06 uses Precision mirror-image turbos and custom tuning to deliver 810 rear-wheel horsepower on 93 octane.
Chevrolet rates the 2027 Corvette Z06's naturally aspirated 5.5-liter V8 at 670 horsepower, with peak power at 8,400 rpm and a redline of 8,600 rpm from a flat-plane crank.
Houston-based Late Model Racecraft figured that wasn't enough for one customer's C8.
The result is a Z06 that now runs on 93-octane pump gas instead of its earlier E85 setup, with numbers that embarrass its factory sibling.

items.title: 国産初の乗り合いバス、1929年製スミダM型バス…日本自動車殿堂の「歴史遺産車」に選出
items.summary:
いすゞ自動車は、同社の前身である石川島自動車製作所が1929年に製造した「スミダM型バス」が、日本自動車殿堂の「歴史遺産車」に選出されたと発表した。
いすゞ車両の歴史遺産車選定は、2014年の「117クーペ」、2019年の初代「エルフ」に続き3台目となる。
スミダM型バスは、外国メーカーの車両が主流だった時代に国産自動車技術の確立を目指して製造された国産初の乗り合いバスだ。当時の公共交通網の近代化に貢献したことが高く評価されている。

items.summary: We though a puncture was bad enough, until our home charger stopped working Your car can be as fancy-pants-new and technology-led as you like, but whatever you do, it’s bloody hard to get away from the oldest motoring tribulation in the book: a punctured tyre. Now, on this particular occasion, I’d only driven five minutes down the road to a gong bath. At a guess, I’d say most of you reading this a
facts: So there I was, post-gong bath, in a happy haze of relaxation, when I stepped back into the Volvo ES90 and heard a ping.
The relevant screen said the nearside tyre was 31psi while the rest were 40.
I drove straight home, given it was so close, and didn’t take long to find an awkwardly angled nail deep into the tyre, along with the considerable sound of air quickly escaping.

There was little I could do at the time – the ES90 comes equipped with a temporary puncture repair kit rather than a spare – and, as expected, when I woke up in the morning, the tyre was royally flat.

高度化するADAS、普及のカギは『コストと統合』…ヴァレオが描く自動運転の未来と現実解
items.summary:
フランスの自動車部品大手ヴァレオは10月29日、ADAS（先進運転支援システム）と自動運転の最新動向について説明会を開催した。高度な運転支援の普及を見据え、駐車の自動化やセンサーの進化、コスト低減に取り組む同社の技術と戦略を探った。
◆高度化するレベル2でも運転の監視は必要
この日、説明会に登壇したのは、ヴァレオでカスタマー・チーフエンジニアを務める沼田祐也氏。沼田氏は、高齢化や公共交通の縮小が進む日本では、交通事故を減らすとともに、移動手段を確保する技術としても期待が高まっているとし、ドライバーが監視する高度な運転支援を広く普及させながら、駐車を含めた自動運転へ発展させる方向性を示した。
その説明で押さえておくべきは、「運転支援」と「自動運転」の違いである。自動運転のレベルは米国自動車技術協会（SAE）によって、レベル0～レベル5までの6段階に分類され、運転の主導権と責任が「人」から「シ
facts: フランスの自動車部品大手ヴァレオは10月29日、ADAS（先進運転支援システム）と自動運転の最新動向について説明会を開催した。
◆高度化するレベル2でも運転の監視は必要
自動運転のレベルは米国自動車技術協会（SAE）によって、レベル0～レベル5までの6段階に分類され、運転の主導権と責任が「人」から「システム」へどのように移行するかで定義されている。
この中でレベル2は、システムがアクセルやブレーキ、ハンドルの操作を組み合わせることで一定の自動化により運転を支援するが、周囲を監視し、安全を確認する役割はドライバーにある。
条件によってハンドルから手を離せても、前方を見なくてよいわけではない。
一方、レベル3では、定められた条件内でシステムが運転を担い、ドライバーは常時の周辺監視から解放される。
さらにレベル4になると、その条件内では運転の継続が難しくなった場合の対応までシステムが担うこととなる。
そんな中で今回、とくに重点的に説明されたのが、「レベル2＋」「レベル2＋＋」についてだ。
これらはSAEによる正式な区分ではなく、高度なレベル2の機能を説明するための呼称であり、ヴァレオとしては高速道路でナビゲーションの経路に沿って走行を支援するものをレベル2＋、一般道まで対象を広げるものをレベル2＋＋として紹介した。
具体的には、目的地までの経路に応じて車線変更なども支援するが、ドライバーによる監視が前提である点はレベル2と変わらない。
道路を走るときに比べ、ハンドルを左右へ大きく切り、前進と後退を繰り返しながら、車体を狭い空間へ正確に収めなければならない。

facts: As Formula 1 returns to Rwanda, motorsport’s commercial future collides with traditional racing heartlands There's no place on the Formula 1 calendar for a grand prix in France or Germany, but there will be in the next few years for one in Rwanda.
That sums up the state of play, for not just F1 but the majority of international sport today.

Uninspiring Paul Ricard hasn't been mourned by many F1 teams, drivers or fans (who aren't French) since it dropped off the schedule after 2022, although it's faintly astonishing that Germany hasn't hosted a race since the one-off Eifel GP at the Nürburgring in Covid-affected 2020, especially with Audi having joined Mercedes on the grid.
